flashinfer: 0.7.3 stock pinned release; verify loaded wheel and native providers
hardware: one exclusive H100; same allocation for both arms
checks: eager vs graph logits original/changed/restored inputs
no new profiling in serving or warm process
skip-op, disable tuning, disable graphs, cache reuse off
strict miss and error restoration controls

performance.order: ABBA then BAAB; two independent cold seeds per arm, fresh warm serving processes
metrics: synchronized full decode path wall time
performance.criterion: For every tested shape, paired median scoped/baseline latency <=1.03; if excess or CI includes >1.03, investigate and repeat only the ambiguous case. No statistically supported regression accepted. Neutral within noise is sufficient. Separate cold startup from serving.

publication: source and results on leejnau fork; no PR until user requests
